## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important defect needs fixing: `status()` shortens the revision to 7 characters, but `history()` and `completed()` use 12. The new status line therefore shows a different identifier than the docstring promises. No other defects were found in the two changed files.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — For `REVISION = "0123456789abcdef…"`, `status(REVISION, 2)` returns `"Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)"`, while `history(REVISION)` returns `"History: 0123456789ab"`, so the running status uses a different identifier than history. The docstring at `app/display.py:13` says "Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history", but line 14 uses `revision[:7]` and `history` at `app/display.py:5` uses `revision[:12]`. The added test at `tests/test_display.py:14-15` only checks the `"Running: "` prefix and `"(attempt 2)"` suffix, so it cannot catch this. To fix: change line 14 to `revision[:12]`, or share one helper with `history`/`completed`, and assert the full string `"Running: 0123456789ab (attempt 2)"` in the test. — Operators matching a running deployment against history or "Deployed:" lines see a 7-character prefix where those lines show 12, so they can't match the entries by string. The current test would also let a future truncation change slip through.
